item.title: Clinic Inbox Checks
item.description: A simulated clinic inbox where an AI agent handles patient messages under a written policy, and checks that read the server’s own record decide whether each run followed it. I built it with coding agents in October 2026.

item.title: Tiny Stories / RPG Demo
item.description: An interactive story system I built with coding agents in 2026: one premise becomes a 12-turn story with a player role, an advisor that cannot change the story, persistent sessions, replay, and a reviewer view.

item.title: Auto Load-Off Test
